audit_kind: Independent read-only arithmetic/phase audit; no benchmark, test, build, compression or source edit
scope_notes: Warm/cold are separate measurements: cold means store drop/reopen before each append, not OS page-cache eviction or hardware-cold I/O.

append_ns measures only append_canonical; cold operation CPU/write brackets include process sampling overhead but exclude reopen. Warm counters span the whole append phase. Lifecycle includes history seeding and later reopen verification.

SC_CLK_TCK=100 gives 10 ms CPU ticks. Dividing 32 appends gives 0.3125 ms/append units. Small warm phase totals are only 1-5 ticks. Cold sums 32 separate rounded counter brackets; zero brackets do not mean CPU-free work and quantization error can accumulate across brackets. Prefer whole cold phase counters for a less quantized corroboration; they include reopens.
No CPU counter or required memory sample is missing in these 48 append files. All write amounts and file footprints are identical within each before/after pair.

All medians below are medians of three per-process measurements or three matched pair ratios. Do not substitute ratio of unpaired medians, discard the outlier, or interpret 3 pairs as precise population estimates.

findings: The 9036.779266 ms vs 2587.514690 ms process durations agree with internal lifecycle 9031.137 ms vs 2582.001 ms, plus approximately 5 ms process/reporting overhead. The outlier is retained.

Of the internal 6449.136 ms excess, seed/init contributes 5908.658 ms (91.62%); append/reopen phase contributes 538.071 ms (8.34%). Measured append calls alone total 286.549955 ms vs 93.251288 ms; the remaining phase increase is reopen, sampling and driver overhead.

Lifetime self CPU rises 490 ms (2770 vs 2280 ms); seed CPU rises 430 ms and append/reopen CPU 50 ms. Approximately 5959 ms of extra wall time is not matched by extra self CPU. These counters cannot distinguish storage waits, scheduling delay or host contention, and do not establish a root cause.
Write-byte deltas match at every lifecycle phase, all append operation write totals match, and all final/preclose file sizes match. No extra data volume explains the slowdown.
Candidate cold history2048 paired mean-append ratios are 0.949925, 1.079834, 3.072879; retain median 1.079834 and full range. This cohort does not support a uniform cold-append speedup.

runtime_recompute_audit.scope: Checked all 144 reported arithmetic records and all paired statistics from recomputed.json; raw hashes/counters/memory spot-checked in four listed files, not an independent rerun of every runtime raw input. Same-engine full semantic equality and cross-engine core equality remain distinct.
